statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-21714 is a Node.js HTTP/2 memory leak: WINDOW_UPDATE frames on stream 0 that overflow the connection flow-control window make the server send GOAWAY but never clean up the Http2Session. Node.js fixed it for 22.x in 22.22.2, the 2026-03-24 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/march-2026-security-releases), with commit 2a6105a63b, 'src: handle NGHTTP2_ERR_FLOW_CONTROL error code' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/2a6105a63b), which carries this CVE id. Release notes: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.22.2. The CVE record (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-21714) lists 22.x releases through 22.22.1 as affected. We read the node binary in every published DHI nodejs-22 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64: 22.22.2-r0 is the first that reports Node.js v22.22.2; 22.22.0-r0 and 22.22.1-r0 report Node.js 22.22.0 and 22.22.1. We also ran upstream's regression test for the fix (test/parallel/test-http2-window-update-overflow.js) against every published Alpine 3.23 aarch64 build: it does not complete and is killed after 180 seconds on 22.22.0-r0 and 22.22.1-r0, and passes on 22.22.2-r0 through 22.23.5-r0. Both earlier builds predate the fix, so the range starts at 0.

CVE-2026-21714 is a memory leak in Node.js HTTP/2 servers: when a client sends WINDOW_UPDATE frames on stream 0 that push the connection flow-control window past 2^31-1, the server sends GOAWAY but never cleans up the Http2Session. Node.js fixed it for 24.x in 24.14.1, the 2026-03-24 security release, which lists 24.x among the affected lines: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/march-2026-security-releases. The fix is commit https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/c015edf313, 'src: handle NGHTTP2_ERR_FLOW_CONTROL error code', which carries this CVE id. Release notes: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.14.1. We read the node binary in the DHI nodejs-24 packages for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64 from the first published build through the boundary, each checked against its index checksum: 24.13.0-r0, 24.13.1-r0 and 24.14.0-r0 report Node.js v24.13.0, v24.13.1 and v24.14.0, and 24.14.1-r0 is the first that reports Node.js v24.14.1. The later packages in the DHI Alpine repository are versioned 24.15.0-r0 to 24.22.3-r0.
